def count_nums(arr)
  arr.count do |num|
    digits = num.abs.to_s.chars.map(&:to_i)
    signed_sum = digits.sum - (num < 0 ? 2 * digits.first : 0)
    signed_sum > 0
  end
end

def get_max_triples(n)
  # a[i] = i*i - i + 1 for i in 1..n
  # Residue of a[i] mod 3 depends on i mod 3:
  #   i ≡ 0 -> a[i] ≡ 1
  #   i ≡ 1 -> a[i] ≡ 1
  #   i ≡ 2 -> a[i] ≡ 0
  # So only triples with all residues 0 or all residues 1 sum to a multiple of 3.
  c0 = (n >= 2) ? ((n - 2) / 3 + 1) : 0   # count of i with i ≡ 2 (mod 3) -> residue 0
  c1 = n - c0                             # count of i with residue 1

  c0 * (c0 - 1) * (c0 - 2) / 6 + c1 * (c1 - 1) * (c1 - 2) / 6
end

problems.name: HumanEval_129_minPath
problems.code:
def minPath(grid, k)
  n = grid.size
  si = sj = nil
  (0...n).each do |i|
    (0...n).each do |j|
      if grid[i][j] == 1
        si, sj = i, j
      end
    end
  end

  result = []
  ci, cj = si, sj
  k.times do
    result << grid[ci][cj]
    best_val = nil
    bi = bj = nil
    [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]].each do |di, dj|
      ni, nj = ci + di, cj + dj
      next if ni < 0 || ni >= n || nj < 0 || nj >= n
      v = grid[ni][nj]
      if best_val.nil? || v < best_val
        best_val = v
        bi, bj = ni, nj
      end
    end
    ci, cj = bi, bj
  end
  result
end

  primes = []

        is_prime = false
        break
